exercises.question: A magnetic flux through a coil changes by 0.5 Wb in 0.1 seconds. Find the induced EMF if the coil has 10 turns.
exercises.question_amharic: በ 10 ጠምዛዛ ሽቦ ውስጥ ያለው ማግኔቲክ ፍላክስ በ 0.1 ሰከንድ ውስጥ በ 0.5 Wb ተለወጠ። የተፈጠረውን EMF ፈልጉ።
exercises.step_by_step_explanation: 1. Identify N = 10, ΔΦ = 0.5 Wb, Δt = 0.1 s.\n2. Compute ΔΦ / Δt = 0.5 / 0.1 = 5 Wb/s.\n3. Multiply by N and apply direction: ε = -10 * 5 = -50 V.
exercises.step_by_step_explanation_amharic: 1. Identify N = 10, ΔΦ = 0.5 Wb, Δt = 0.1 s.\n2. Compute ΔΦ / Δt = 0.5 / 0.1 = 5 Wb/s.\n3. Multiply by N and apply direction: ε = -10 * 5 = -50 V.
